lines.en: Grandma, what are these little seeds?
Flower seeds. Let's plant them in the garden.
How do I put them in the soil?
Push them into the soil with your finger.
Like this? Now I will water them.
Good. Not too much water.
When will the flowers grow?
In a few weeks. Last spring, they grew fast.
lines.ko: 몇 주 뒤에요. 지난봄에는 빨리 자랐어요.

lines.en: I planted a tree at school last month.
Great! Green leaves will come out soon.
lines.ko: 멋져요! 곧 초록 잎이 나올 거예요.

dialogs.about: 이웃과 꽃에 물 주는 시간 이야기

lines.en: Good morning! Your garden looks so green.
Thank you. When do you water your flowers?
Early in the morning, before it gets hot.
I watered my flowers in the afternoon yesterday.
The sun is too strong at that time. Try evening.
lines.ko: 그 시간에는 해가 너무 강해요. 저녁에 해 봐요.

lines.en: I will water them this evening.
Do the leaves on this tree look dry?
A little. The soil is dry, too.
Will you give the tree water, too?
Yes. Thank you for your help, neighbor.
